moq.a: Clothing packaging — garment bags, zipper bags and hang tags — starts at 300 pieces. All other packaging starts at 1,000 pieces.

artwork.q: What artwork files do you need?
artwork.a: Send whatever you have. If you already have print-ready artwork we will check it and proof it; if you do not, our team prepares it for you.

sample.q: Do I get a sample before the full run?
sample.a: Yes, always. We produce a physical sample and production only begins once you approve it. What you sign off on is what gets delivered.

lead.q: How long does an order take?
lead.a: CONFIRM WITH MEDIA PRINT — we have not published a lead time. Production starts the moment you approve the sample; talk to sales for a date on your specific job.

shipping.a: Every governorate in Egypt, and to the Arab countries. Shipping is arranged once the run is finished and quality-checked.

design.q: Can you design the packaging for me?
design.a: Yes. Design and artwork are done in-house alongside the printing, so nothing gets lost between suppliers.
